1  THE 1ST RESPONDENT BEFORE THE 5TH RESPONDENT

NITIN JAMDAR, C.J.
 &
 S.MANU, J.

=========================
 Dated this the 10th day of October, 2024  ORDER NITIN JAMDAR, C.J.
None appears for the Appellant.

Heard Sri.K.P. Harish, learned Senior Government Pleader for Respondent Nos. 4 to 6.
2.
The Writ petition was filed by the Appellant challenging the order dated 4 March 2024 of the Arbitrator under the National Highways Act, 1956.
The question arises is whether the Writ Petition itself was maintainable.
3. By way of one opportunity, post on 6 November 2024.
4. If none appears for the Appellant on that day, the Court will proceed in the absence of the Appellant.

Sd/-
NITIN JAMDAR CHIEF JUSTICE Sd/-
S.MANU JUDGE SPV 10-10-2024 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Muhammed C vs Competent Authority [Cala-Nh] on 10 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8811076/
